beats.say: A giant octopus was nearly the star of the first Godzilla film.
The project began after a Japanese Indonesian co production collapsed, leaving the studio needing a new idea.
Eiji Tsuburaya originally proposed a giant octopus, but the team decided on a dinosaur inspired creature instead.
They pioneered a special effects form called suitmation, where a stunt performer wearing a suit interacts with miniature sets.
Principal photography ran 51 days, special effects photography ran 71 days, and that is why a giant octopus.
